scope: Cloudflare hosted component-library folder create/read/cleanup proof

browserJourney.note: The foreground Chrome window moved to a different site before template proof could be run. This artifact covers the already completed hosted folder mutation only.

remoteD1CreateReadback.command: bunx wrangler d1 execute archestimator-proof-db --remote --command "SELECT id, workspace_id, parent_id, name, sort_order, source_category_node_id, folder_kind, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM library_folders WHERE name = 'Codex CF Folder Proof 20260702T050951Z' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;"

remoteD1CleanupReadback.command: bunx wrangler d1 execute archestimator-proof-db --remote --command "DELETE FROM library_folders WHERE id = 'e3deaa00-cde3-4edc-8660-5d44b77ae431' AND workspace_id = '258b50ee-3fde-4f6a-a9d9-c360ec44cd0b' AND name = 'Codex CF Folder Proof 20260702T050951Z'; SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM library_folders WHERE id = 'e3deaa00-cde3-4edc-8660-5d44b77ae431' OR name = 'Codex CF Folder Proof 20260702T050951Z';"

boundary: This proof covers a signed-in production UI folder create on the Cloudflare-hosted component library, remote D1 persistence readback, and scoped cleanup of the empty throwaway folder. It does not cover hosted estimate-template mutation or viewer-denial behavior.
